name: Zone 1 · Daily - Greens and kitchen garden
notes:
What it is: the everyday picking garden, about 47 m² on the slope just south of the house (towards the barbecue). Salad and cooking greens you grab daily – kept closest to the kitchen.
Water: roof rainwater or creek water from the 20,000 L tank, by drip at soil level (area A). Never laundry or treated water on leafy greens. Budget about 1,200 L/week in the dry spring.
Layout: 3–4 short beds about 1.2 m wide, cut level across the slope with timber or log edges; mulched paths between; a trellis on the uphill side.
Mix now to Feb (hot, wet): Ceylon spinach on the trellis; Okinawa and Brazilian spinach and sweet potato leaves from cuttings; Egyptian spinach; amaranth; Timor lettuce; Vietnamese mint in a pot. Lettuce only under 30–50% shade cloth.
Mix Mar–Aug (main season): lettuce, rocket, mizuna, mustard (sow every 2–3 weeks); bok choy, kailaan; kale, silverbeet; spring onion, coriander, parsley.
All year at the edges: garlic chives, Timor lettuce, a comfrey plant at the downhill corner for mulch and compost.
Tips: net brassicas in Feb–Mar (caterpillar peak); top up compost each change of season.
From the water-source plan (18 Oct) and kitchen-garden notes – adjust on site.
